comingLast.roast: finished on 22 - his mates have formed a guard at the exit
one decent hole (5 points) and he slips the blue ball noose onto Forsyth
3 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
safe by 1 - unless Forsyth finds form, in which case, gulp
a 1-point cushion over Forsyth - thin ice, heavy walker
clear of Forsyth by 1 - nobody tell him, he plays worse informed
3 above the blue line - the bar keeps updating his odds
